verdict.rationale: Superpowers ships executable skills and a third-party marketplace (obra/superpowers-marketplace) but the evidence pack contains no security-posture documentation covering what skills can execute, a trust model for vetting third-party skills, or telemetry/data-collection disclosures. Community commentary even flags the install mechanism as resembling 'curl|bash... with added LLM agents' without any vendor response on trust vetting, and no telemetry statement appears anywhere in docs.
